subject: MVTHS Graphic Design Shop Profile
overview: The Graphic Design department at Medford Vocational Technical High School presented a profile of its curriculum, instructional philosophy, and career preparation pathways.

items.title: Program Introduction
items.summary: Instructor Lou Spagnola and students Blake, John McLaughlin, and Marcus introduced the Medford Vocational Technical High School Graphic Design program.

items.title: Instructional Philosophy and Environment
items.summary: Spagnola and students discussed the shop's emphasis on maintaining a comfortable, creative environment that prioritizes industry standards over busy work.

items.title: Curriculum and Career Preparation
items.summary: The presentation detailed training in logo creation, branding, and sign making, which prepares students for both higher education and immediate entry into the workforce.
